test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Ministry of Culture organised a flagship festival to achieve the goal of 'Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat' in West Bengal in February 2021. What was the name of that festival?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Rashtriya Sanskriti Mahotsav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **second phase **of the **Rashtriya Sanskriti Mahotsav** at Raj Bhawan in** Darjeeling, West Bengal.**
 
• It is organized to promote the spirit of** Ek Bharat Sreshtha Bharat.**
 
• **11th edition** of 'Rashtriya Sanskriti Mahotsav' on **February 14, 2021.**
 
• Ten editions were organized in Delhi, Bengaluru, Varanasi, Tawang, Karnataka, Gujarat, Tehri, and Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Rashtriya Sanskriti Mahotsav**:

 
 
• It is a flagship festival of the **Ministry of culture and tourism**. Minister: **G. Kishan Reddy.**
 
• The event is organized since **2015.**
 
• It witnesses the active participation of** seven Zonal Culture Centres.**
 
• These zonal centers play a key role in taking the vibrant culture of India to the masses rather than confining it to auditoria and galleries.
 
• This festival showcases the **folk and tribal art, music, dance, cuisines, and culture of one state in other states**.
